title: Digital Minimalism and the Problem of Too Much Choice

article.heading: Choices and Stress
article.paragraph: In the modern world, people are surrounded by an enormous number of choices. From streaming services and online shopping to social media and mobile applications, we are constantly required to decide what to watch, buy, read, or follow. Although having more options may seem like a sign of freedom, too much choice can actually create stress and reduce our overall satisfaction.

article.heading: What Is Digital Minimalism?
article.paragraph: For this reason, digital minimalism has become increasingly important. Digital minimalism is the idea of using technology in a more intentional and controlled way. Instead of downloading every new app or spending hours scrolling through endless content, digital minimalists choose only the tools that provide real value to their lives. This approach allows people to focus on what is genuinely important rather than being distracted by unnecessary information.

article.heading: Decision Fatigue
article.paragraph: One major problem caused by excessive choice is decision fatigue. When people are exposed to hundreds of products, videos, or opinions every day, making even simple decisions can become exhausting. For example, choosing a film on a streaming platform may take longer than actually watching it because there are too many options. As a result, people may feel dissatisfied with their final choice and continue wondering whether another option would have been better.

article.heading: Creating Digital Boundaries
article.paragraph: Digital minimalism can help solve this problem by reducing unnecessary decisions. People can limit the number of applications they use, turn off non-essential notifications, and set specific times for checking social media. By creating these boundaries, they can save mental energy and improve their ability to concentrate.

article.heading: Using Technology with Intention
article.paragraph: However, digital minimalism does not mean completely rejecting technology. Technology remains extremely useful for education, communication, and work. The key is to control technology rather than allowing it to control our attention. In my view, learning to live with fewer digital distractions is becoming an essential skill. By reducing the overload of choice, people can make clearer decisions, enjoy their free time more fully, and focus on the things that truly matter.

sentence_interpretations.sentence: In the modern world, people are surrounded by an enormous number of choices.
sentence_interpretations.translation: 현대 사회에서 사람들은 엄청나게 많은 선택지에 둘러싸여 있다.
sentence_interpretations.learning_note: be surrounded by는 ‘~에 둘러싸여 있다’라는 수동태 표현입니다.

sentence_interpretations.sentence: From streaming services and online shopping to social media and mobile applications, we are constantly required to decide what to watch, buy, read, or follow.
sentence_interpretations.translation: 스트리밍 서비스와 온라인 쇼핑부터 소셜 미디어와 모바일 애플리케이션까지, 우리는 무엇을 보고, 사고, 읽고, 팔로우할지를 끊임없이 결정해야 한다.
sentence_interpretations.learning_note: From A to B는 범위를 나타내며, what to watch와 같은 의문사+to부정사는 ‘무엇을 ~할지’를 의미합니다.

sentence_interpretations.sentence: Although having more options may seem like a sign of freedom, too much choice can actually create stress and reduce our overall satisfaction.
sentence_interpretations.translation: 더 많은 선택지가 자유의 상징처럼 보일 수 있지만, 지나치게 많은 선택은 오히려 스트레스를 만들고 전반적인 만족도를 낮출 수 있다.
sentence_interpretations.learning_note: Although는 양보를 나타내며, may seem like A는 ‘A처럼 보일 수 있다’라는 뜻입니다.

sentence_interpretations.sentence: For this reason, digital minimalism has become increasingly important.
sentence_interpretations.translation: 이러한 이유로 디지털 미니멀리즘은 점점 더 중요해지고 있다.
sentence_interpretations.learning_note: For this reason은 앞의 내용을 원인으로 받아 ‘이러한 이유로’라고 연결합니다.

sentence_interpretations.sentence: Digital minimalism is the idea of using technology in a more intentional and controlled way.
sentence_interpretations.translation: 디지털 미니멀리즘은 기술을 보다 의도적이고 통제된 방식으로 사용하는 것을 의미한다.
sentence_interpretations.learning_note: the idea of -ing는 ‘~하는 생각 또는 개념’이라는 정의 표현입니다.

sentence_interpretations.sentence: Instead of downloading every new app or spending hours scrolling through endless content, digital minimalists choose only the tools that provide real value to their lives.
sentence_interpretations.translation: 새로운 앱을 모두 다운로드하거나 끝없는 콘텐츠를 몇 시간씩 보는 대신, 디지털 미니멀리스트들은 자신의 삶에 실제로 가치가 있는 도구만 선택한다.
sentence_interpretations.learning_note: Instead of -ing는 ‘~하는 대신’이며, that provide는 tools를 수식하는 관계대명사절입니다.

sentence_interpretations.sentence: This approach allows people to focus on what is genuinely important rather than being distracted by unnecessary information.
sentence_interpretations.translation: 이러한 방식은 사람들이 불필요한 정보에 방해받기보다 진정으로 중요한 것에 집중할 수 있도록 해준다.
sentence_interpretations.learning_note: allow A to do는 ‘A가 ~하도록 허용하다’이며, rather than은 ‘~하기보다’라는 대조를 만듭니다.

sentence_interpretations.sentence: One major problem caused by excessive choice is decision fatigue.
sentence_interpretations.translation: 과도한 선택이 만들어내는 대표적인 문제 중 하나는 결정 피로이다.
sentence_interpretations.learning_note: caused by excessive choice는 problem을 뒤에서 수식하는 과거분사구입니다.

sentence_interpretations.sentence: When people are exposed to hundreds of products, videos, or opinions every day, making even simple decisions can become exhausting.
sentence_interpretations.translation: 사람들이 매일 수백 개의 상품, 영상, 의견에 노출되면 간단한 결정을 내리는 것조차 피곤해질 수 있다.
sentence_interpretations.learning_note: be exposed to는 ‘~에 노출되다’이며, making은 동명사 주어입니다.

sentence_interpretations.sentence: For example, choosing a film on a streaming platform may take longer than actually watching it because there are too many options.
sentence_interpretations.translation: 예를 들어, 스트리밍 플랫폼에서는 선택지가 너무 많아 영화를 실제로 보는 시간보다 고르는 시간이 더 오래 걸릴 수도 있다.
sentence_interpretations.learning_note: take longer than은 ‘~보다 더 오래 걸리다’이며, choosing이 문장의 주어입니다.

sentence_interpretations.sentence: As a result, people may feel dissatisfied with their final choice and continue wondering whether another option would have been better.
sentence_interpretations.translation: 그 결과, 사람들은 자신의 최종 선택에 만족하지 못하고 다른 선택이 더 나았을지 계속 고민할 수 있다.
sentence_interpretations.learning_note: whether another option would have been better는 ‘다른 선택이 더 나았을지’라는 간접의문문입니다.

sentence_interpretations.sentence: Digital minimalism can help solve this problem by reducing unnecessary decisions.
sentence_interpretations.translation: 디지털 미니멀리즘은 불필요한 결정을 줄임으로써 이러한 문제를 해결하는 데 도움을 줄 수 있다.

sentence_interpretations.sentence: People can limit the number of applications they use, turn off non-essential notifications, and set specific times for checking social media.
sentence_interpretations.translation: 사람들은 사용하는 애플리케이션의 수를 제한하고, 중요하지 않은 알림을 끄며, 소셜 미디어를 확인하는 시간을 정할 수 있다.
sentence_interpretations.learning_note: limit, turn off, set이 and로 연결된 병렬 구조입니다.

sentence_interpretations.sentence: By creating these boundaries, they can save mental energy and improve their ability to concentrate.
sentence_interpretations.translation: 이러한 경계를 만들면 정신적 에너지를 절약하고 집중력을 향상시킬 수 있다.
sentence_interpretations.learning_note: By creating these boundaries는 ‘이러한 경계를 만듦으로써’라는 방법을 나타냅니다.

sentence_interpretations.sentence: However, digital minimalism does not mean completely rejecting technology.
sentence_interpretations.translation: 하지만 디지털 미니멀리즘이 기술을 완전히 거부한다는 뜻은 아니다.
sentence_interpretations.learning_note: does not mean -ing는 ‘~한다는 뜻은 아니다’라는 표현입니다.

sentence_interpretations.sentence: Technology remains extremely useful for education, communication, and work.
sentence_interpretations.translation: 기술은 여전히 교육, 의사소통, 업무에 매우 유용하다.

sentence_interpretations.sentence: The key is to control technology rather than allowing it to control our attention.
sentence_interpretations.translation: 핵심은 기술이 우리의 관심을 통제하도록 두는 것이 아니라 우리가 기술을 통제하는 것이다.
sentence_interpretations.learning_note: rather than은 두 행동을 대조하며, allow A to control B는 ‘A가 B를 통제하도록 내버려 두다’입니다.

sentence_interpretations.sentence: In my view, learning to live with fewer digital distractions is becoming an essential skill.
sentence_interpretations.translation: 내 생각에는 디지털 방해 요소를 줄이며 살아가는 법을 배우는 것이 점점 더 필수적인 능력이 되고 있다.
sentence_interpretations.learning_note: learning to live는 동명사 주어이며, fewer는 셀 수 있는 명사의 수가 더 적다는 뜻입니다.

sentence_interpretations.sentence: By reducing the overload of choice, people can make clearer decisions, enjoy their free time more fully, and focus on the things that truly matter.
sentence_interpretations.translation: 선택의 과부하를 줄이면 사람들은 더 명확한 결정을 내리고, 여가 시간을 더욱 충실하게 즐기며, 진정으로 중요한 것에 집중할 수 있다.
sentence_interpretations.learning_note: make, enjoy, focus가 and로 연결된 병렬 구조이며, that truly matter는 things를 수식합니다.

conversation_questions.question: How does having too many choices affect your daily life?
conversation_questions.sample_answer: Having too many choices can make simple decisions exhausting, especially when I choose something to watch online.
conversation_questions.coaching_point: Use can make + object + adjective to describe an effect.

conversation_questions.question: What digital tools provide real value to your life?
conversation_questions.sample_answer: A calendar app and a note-taking app provide real value because they help me organize my work.
conversation_questions.coaching_point: Use because to explain why a tool is valuable.

conversation_questions.question: What is one digital boundary you would like to create?
conversation_questions.sample_answer: I would like to turn off non-essential notifications and check social media only twice a day.
conversation_questions.coaching_point: Use would like to when describing a goal or preferred change.
